values.note: Two self-serve lots in Jordan: 242 Montana Street (8 large back-in and 2 tandem pull-through sites) and 622 Marguerite Street (6 back-in sites). All gravel and level; 'Can accommodate most any size RV!'

values.note: Montana Street lot: 'Power and sewer are available year round and water is available dependent on the Eastern Montana winter weather.'
Self-serve; 'Call or text 406-853-0020 or 406-853-2970 and we will make sure we have a site available for your stay.' Pay at the self-service station.

note: Self-serve private RV park in the town of Jordan off Highway 200, in two lots: 242 Montana Street (near the town park and school) and 622 Marguerite Street. The name refers to a former dorm building; it is a real transient RV park. --Claude
summary: Operator site: confirmed 16 sites (10 + 6 in two lots), 50-amp full hookups, pull-throughs, $35 full hookup (fees left as recorded 2026-10-16); added year-round power/sewer (water weather-dependent) and phone/text booking. Not stated: a max rig length. Note trimmed of restated values.
